$comment: The Contributors page (/contributors/): buttons in two tiers for each area of The Labs, the Contributor pin, and the pinning ceremony at the quarterly regional summits. The board designates the core areas; until it does, only Ambassador is named and the rest read as open. The roll of Contributors reads data/contributors.json. [PLACEHOLDER] marks copy to confirm.
title: Contributors
description: A button for every area of The Labs, in two tiers. Oriented and Practiced in every core area, and you're pinned at a regional summit. A Contributor for life.

hero.title: The Contributor pin.
hero.lede: For people who've learned every part of The Labs by doing it. Pinned in front of your region. Yours for life.
hero.alt: The Contributor pin: the orb mark in polished nickel with teal and red cat-eye enamel

tiers.title: One button for every area. Two tiers.
tiers.lede: Every area that keeps The Labs running has its own button. You earn it twice.

items.title: Oriented
items.body: You've done the area's orientation: a short film or read, a quick check, and its agreement. The area's lead hands you the button.
items.label: Oriented

items.title: Practiced
items.body: You've done the real work, for long enough to know it. The area's lead confirms it, and your button gets its mark.
items.label: Practiced

tiers.mark: The Practiced mark on the physical button is still to be designed. [PLACEHOLDER]
tiers.buttonAlt: An area button: the orb mark on ink, ringed in white

areas.title: Set by the board.
areas.lede: The board decides which areas are core. The pin takes all of them.
areas.open: To be set by the board

core.name: Ambassador
core.oriented: Get in: the film, the coordinator's questions, the agreement.
core.practiced: Pass it on: [N] new Upskillers, one talk, one new ambassador.

areas.electives: Other areas offer elective buttons. Collect them because you care about the work. They don't count toward the pin.

steps.title: Put forward.
steps.body: OLOS shows you're there. A coordinator or an area lead nominates you.

steps.title: Confirmed.
steps.body: The core team for your region, or HQ, confirms it.

steps.title: Pinned.
steps.body: At the next regional summit, in front of everyone.

ceremony.title: Pinned at the summit.
ceremony.lede: Every quarter, each region holds a summit. The pinning is part of it. [PLACEHOLDER: the run of show is a draft.]

moments.label: Your name
moments.body: Called out, with the areas you've worked in.

moments.label: Your sponsor
moments.body: Someone who already wears the pin pins it on you.

moments.label: One line
moments.body: They say, in a sentence, what you did.

moments.label: The roll
moments.body: Your name goes on the roll, for good.

ceremony.first: At the first summit nobody wears the pin yet, so the founders and the board do the pinning.

items.title: The roll never shrinks.
items.body: Your name stays, whatever comes next.

items.title: Step back any time.
items.body: You become an alum, not an ex. The pin is still yours.

items.title: One exception.
items.body: A serious breach of the Code of Conduct.

roll.title: Contributors.
roll.empty: Nobody yet. The first pinning is at the next regional summit.
roll.label: Contributors, {n} pinned

items.a: The board decides. Ambassador is the first. The rest are named as the board sets them.
Not toward the pin. They count toward knowing The Labs.
No. Take the time it takes.
Your coordinator, or the lead of any area you've worked in.
You stay on the roll as an alum. The pin is yours.

join.title: Start with one button.
join.lede: Most people start as an ambassador. Ten minutes to get in.

footer.renders: Images of the button and pin are 3D renders, not photos.
